snippet.title: Belts of Iron Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the announcement trailer for Belts of Iron, an upcoming open-world, third-person factory building game where survival and automation go hand in hand.

Wishlist on Steam today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427850?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer

In Belts of Iron, you'll explore a vast procedurally generated world, gather resources, and construct massive automated factories powered by electricity and connected by intricate conveyor belt networks. Manage power, craft weapons, and fortify your base to withstand attacks from native creatures. Play solo or team up with friends in online or LAN co-op to push your factory, and your survival, to the limit.

#indiegame #steam #automation #pcgaming
